decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Mechanical Ventilation & Environmental Control Equipment, Assessment of Fixed Plant Equipment Noise 1716685, 0000/G2016/G210 revision E, 0000/2016/G213/16-0025 revision G, 0000/2016/G100/16-0025 revision Q, 0000/2016/G099/16-0025 revision C, Design and Access Statement 16-0025. Received 27/02/2017
KFC Delivery and Servicing Plan. Received 10/04/2017) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The proposals contained within the submitted Mechanical Ventilation & Environmental Control Equipment and Assessment of Fixed Plant Equipment Noise 1716685 reports shall be installed as specified prior to the commencement of the approved use and permanently retained thereafter.

Condition : 4 - The use hereby approved shall not commence until the applicant demonstrates to the Local Planning Authority that they have the right to service the premises from the rear service yard and will continue to be able to do so following implementation of planning permission 00616/F/P19 for redevelopment of land to the north
description: Change of use of vacant retail unit to mixed A3/A5 (restaurant and hot food take-away) installation of replacement shopfront, creation of new rear basement, installation of plant including extraction system and uncovered plant enclosure at first floor level to rear of building.
